summary: WordCraft is a word processor, like Microsoft Word. It reads and writes .docx files. It can also work from typed commands.
use_cases: Make a weekly status report from a list of steps. The headings, table and charts have the same style each time.
Convert a folder of Word files to PDF in 1 step.
Make page previews (PNG) of a document for a website or a chat message.
Start from a template and add the new numbers each month.
story: WordCraft built and formatted the 4-page report. It typed every heading, paragraph and bullet point. It also formatted the share table. It placed 2 GridCraft charts as figures with captions. It added a footer with page numbers and a note that the data is invented. Then it exported the PDF that PdfCraft used.
recipe_note: Type and style the report from a list of steps. Save it as PDF. Make a picture of page 1.

headless_notes: All work ran through wordcraft-cli with no window: run, convert, render, info and text. After insert.picture, the new picture stays selected, so the steps move the caret to the end first. After insert.footer, the caret stays in the footer, so the footer comes last. Formatting at the caret goes into the next paragraphs. The bold and grey text came last, with select.text. A page break inside a heading made a blank page, so the report uses widow control instead. Colours use the form {"Rgb":[r,g,b]}.
